title: Starbucks Iced Peach Green Tea Lemonade (Easy Copycat Recipe)
description: A perfectly balanced and refreshing copycat recipe of the Starbucks Iced Peach Green Tea Lemonade, this drink brings together cool green tea, juicy peaches, and tart lemonade in one glass. You can make it your own with either sweet peach syrup or fresh peach purée, depending on your mood. Every sip is crisp, smooth, and wonderfully chill, just like the real thing, maybe even better.
author: Better Sweet Drinks
ingredients: 1/2 cup chilled green tea (brewed with 1 tea bag & 1 mint leaf)
Choose one: 2 tbsp peach syrup OR 1/4 cup fresh peach purée
Garnish: Peach slice or mint sprig
instructions:
1. Brew green tea with a mint leaf for 3 minutes. Discard tea bag and mint, then chill completely.
  2. Fill a cocktail shaker with ice.
  3. Add the chilled tea, lemonade, and your chosen peach component.
  4. Shake well for 15 seconds until frosty.
  5. Taste, and add simple syrup only if needed. Shake again briefly.
  6. Strain into a tall glass filled with fresh ice. Garnish and serve.
notes:
• If using fresh peach purée, make sure it's smooth and not too chunky for easy mixing.
  • You can double or triple the recipe to make a batch, but shake each serving individually for best texture.
  • Fresh mint adds a subtle layer of flavor that closely matches the Starbucks version—don’t skip it if you can help it.
  • For a stronger tea flavor, use 2 bags per cup of water and steep for exactly 3 minutes.
